_about: What session 68fd4d11 (weevils voice mode, 2026-11-14) published in For you, read back with `weevils read 68fd4d11` and the stored feed. The card's caption claims « interrupt anytime »; the session's own report says interruption mid-answer was never tested on a real iPhone. Regression fixture for evidence labels (shared/evidence.ts).

card.title: weevils · Live voice mode: talk naturally, interrupt anytime, the work still runs on Claude

report.summary: I built the live voice mode for weevboss and published a demo clip, but I still haven't tested an interruption mid-answer on a real iPhone.
report.body:
Le clip est publié dans « for you », avec la légende demandée.

- **Contenu du clip :** un iPhone émulé sur ton instance réelle. Appui long sur le logo, puis la ligne « live · 0:07 · … ¢ » et l'état « weevboss s'en occupe ». Il est muet.
- **Test de l'appui long :** il a lancé une vraie session live, qui a envoyé une demande de plus à weevboss. Ce n'est pas un bug, mais ça s'ajoute à mes tests d'avant dans ton fil.
- **Interruption :** je ne l'ai toujours pas testée en plein milieu d'une réponse.
- **Ce qu'il te reste :** essayer toi-même sur l'iPhone et me dire si la coupure de voix te convient. Je l'ai testée en simulation, mais pas encore avec un vrai micro.

evidence.demonstrated: emulated iPhone on the real instance (silent clip)
limits: Interruption not tested on a real iPhone

commit.message:
feat(voice): live conversation mode through Gemini Live, the work still goes to weevboss

Hold weevboss's logo for a live spoken conversation: Gemini Live (gemini-3.8-live,
native audio, its own turn detection and barge-in) is only the voice layer. Every
concrete request goes to weevboss through sendMain, the same path as a typed message,
and Gemini says the gist of weevboss's written answer.

- server/live.ts: /api/live websocket proxied to Gemini by weevilsd (key in a header,
  never in the browser), same sign-in plus a same-origin check; cost measured from
  Gemini's usage counts; closes after 2 min of silence (30 min ceiling); billing,
  quota and key refusals reach the app as one plain word.
- src/live.ts: 16 kHz PCM capture worklet with a light voice gate, 24 kHz playback
  dropped at once on interruption.
- src/ui/live.tsx: one calm line under the logo (live · time · cost), the masked
  GEMINI_API_KEY field when the key is missing. Cartesia path untouched.
- English or French following the explicit app locale.
